description: Planetary rings (P6-04), transcribed from registered sources (SPEC section 10): radii from the IAU WGPSN Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature (Tier 1), optical depths from the PDS Ring-Moon Systems Node table (Tier 2, no Tier 1 source available to the pipeline). Each value is kept as the text on the page; the pipeline parses it. Saturn's main rings and the gaps the Gazetteer gives with a single width; left out: the Huygens Gap (width given as a range, 285-440 km), the Roche Division and the F, G and E rings (outside the main rings, no optical depth used).

rings.name: D Ring

radii.table: Rings of Saturn, row D, columns Distance (km) from planet's center

optical_depth.table: Rings of Saturn, row D Ring, column Optical Depth

rings.transcriber_note: Extracted on 2026-10-22 by a script from the table rows of the saved pages (cell text as shown on the page; superscripts written as ^) and checked against the pages by eye.
